title: upcode.yaml
description: Configuration for the `upcode` CLI (upcode_ci). Lives next to where `upcode` is run. Paths are relative to this file.

google_project_id.description: Google Cloud / Firebase project id. Required by commands that talk to Google Cloud or Firebase.

google_project_location.description: Cloud project location. Required by the `api:*` commands. Overridden by `--google_project_location`.

base_application_id.description: Default application id. Used for Android and iOS unless `android_application_id` / `ios_application_id` are set.

private_dir.description: Directory containing `service_account.json`. Required by commands that authenticate with Google. Overridden by `--private_dir`.

flutter_dir.description: Path to the Flutter module. Used by most commands, and the default for `modules`. Overridden by `--flutter_dir`.

api_dir.description: Path to the backend module. Required by the `api:*` and `protos` commands. A Dart backend is detected by a `pubspec.yaml` inside it. Overridden by `--api_dir`.

api_dockerfile_dir.description: Dockerfile location when it lives outside `api_dir`. Defaults to `api_dir`. Overridden by `--api_dockerfile_dir`.

protos_dir.description: Directory with the source `.proto` files. Defaults to `<flutter_dir>/res/protos`.

protos_output_dir.description: Output directory for the generated backend protobuf code. Defaults to `<api_dir>/lib/generated/protos` for a Dart backend, `<api_dir>/src/proto` otherwise.

modules.description: Modules acted on by default. Defaults to `[flutter_dir]`.

generated.description: Modules `flutter:buildrunner` runs `build_runner` in. Defaults to none.

analyzed.description: Modules checked by `flutter:analyze` and `dart:analyze`. Defaults to `modules`.

formatted.description: Modules checked by `flutter:format` and `dart:format`. Defaults to `modules`.

api.description: Backend settings used by the `api:*` and `environment` commands. Every scalar value is also written to the generated backend config (`config.ts` / `config.dart`). A nested map keyed by an environment name overrides the scalar values when that `--env` is used.

min_instances.description: Minimum number of Cloud Run instances for the deployed services. Not affected by per-environment overrides. Defaults to 0.

cloudsql_instances.description: Cloud SQL instance connection names attached to every image that does not set its own. Not affected by per-environment overrides.

images.description: One Cloud Run service per image, each routed by an API gateway selector. Defaults to a single image with selector `*`. Not affected by per-environment overrides.

api_config.description: Values `flutter:environment set` writes as `static const String` fields of `Config` in `<flutter_dir>/lib/generated/config.dart`. Keys are converted to lowerCamelCase. A nested map keyed by an environment name overrides the scalar values when that `--env` is used.

test_lab.description: Settings for `upcode testlab run` (Patrol instrumentation tests on Firebase Test Lab).

network_devices.description: Devices for the network-profile matrices. Network profiles only apply to physical devices, so list physical model ids here. Defaults to `devices`.

network_profiles.description: Test Lab network profile ids. One extra matrix is created per profile.

results_bucket.description: Cloud Storage bucket for the uploaded APKs and raw results. Overridden by `--results-bucket`; one of the two is required.

timeout.description: Per-matrix timeout: `<n>s`, `<n>m`, or a bare number of minutes. Overridden by `--timeout`. Defaults to 15 minutes.

use_orchestrator.description: Run tests through Android Test Orchestrator.

clear_package_data.description: Clear app data between test cases (requires the orchestrator).

flaky_test_attempts.description: How many times a failed test execution is re-attempted.

esp_args.description: `ESPv2_ARGS` baked into the Cloud Endpoints proxy image by `api:deploy endpoints`. Defaults to a basic CORS preset that allows gRPC-Web headers.

firebase_client_id.description: OAuth client id of firebase-tools, used by `fad ai-test` to refresh a `firebase login:ci` token. Required together with `firebase_client_secret` when a token is given.

firebase_client_secret.description: OAuth client secret of firebase-tools. See `firebase_client_id`.

env.description: Per-environment overrides. When a command runs with `--env <name>`, the matching entry's keys replace the top-level keys of the same name (maps are replaced, not merged).

propertyNames.description: The normalized environment name: lowercase, with `/` and `-` replaced by `_` (`--env feature/new-login` matches `feature_new_login`).

api_base_name.description: Base name of the Cloud Run backend services. Required by the `api:*` commands.

api_base_display_name.description: Human-readable API name used in the `api_config.yaml` title.

api_version.description: API version suffix appended to service and gateway names.

gateway_base_name.description: Base name of the Cloud Run API gateway service.

gateway_deadline_seconds.description: Backend deadline for gateway routes. Defaults to 15.

cloud_run_hash.description: The hash in the project's Cloud Run URLs (`<service>-<hash>.a.run.app`). `api:environment create` asks for it after the first deploy.

name.description: Suffix added to the service name for this image. Defaults to none.

selector.description: API gateway rule selector routed to this image.

deadline_seconds.description: Backend deadline for this image's route. Defaults to `gateway_deadline_seconds`.

cloudsql_instances.description: Cloud SQL instances for this image. Defaults to `api.cloudsql_instances`.

model.description: Test Lab Android model id (`gcloud firebase test android models list`).
